summary: Ep 35 promoted to an exact record — and it turns out the stored zone was misplaced: ep 35 adapts chs 158-162 (the 'Kanojo to Kareshi' cheer-up-date block) and never touches chs 165-166. Fandom Episode_35 gives '158 (p.5-19), 159, 160, 161, 162'; the episode-title match is exact (ep 35 彼女と彼氏 'Girlfriend and Boyfriend' = the Kanojo to Kareshi chapter block per Wikipedia's chapter list), and the ending is content-locked: MAL's ep-35 thread describes the episode ending on Chizuru's breakdown when the sparkler reminds her of her grandmother, which is precisely ch 162's final page (ch 163 opens with her wiping the tears and Kazuya's 'my perfect girlfriend is..' — ep 36's title beat). The batch-9 'page-level interleaving at the climax' zone {165-166} belongs to ep 36 alone: fandom Episode_36 = 163, 164, 165 (p.1-18), 166 (p.5-19), 167, i.e. the trims/interleave sit inside the S3 finale (chs 165-166 = 'My Girlfriend and Tears 1/2'), chapter-level monotonic throughout. START recorded as 158, not 159: ep 34 only grazes 158 (p.2-5) and ep 35 carries the bulk of the 20-page chapter (p.5-19). No repairs to stored anchors (ep 36 -> 167 v20 unchanged).

anchors.note: S3E11. Fandom infobox: 158 (p. 5-19), 159, 160, 161, 162. START = 158 because ep 35 adapts the bulk of the 20-page chapter (ep 34 ends at 158 p.2-5). annotation_updates.note: corrected zone facts: the page-level trims at the S3 climax sit entirely inside ep 36, which adapts 163, 164, 165 (p.1-18), 166 (p.5-19), 167 — 165 p.19-20 and 166 p.1-4 unadapted; chapter-level monotonic.
